title: Add tests for wp11_openpgp_authenticate and wp11_openpgp_get_ard
description: test/wp11_test_openpgp.c covers wp11_openpgp_select, wp11_openpgp_verify_pw1, and wp11_openpgp_sign but is missing tests for wp11_openpgp_authenticate() (INTERNAL AUTHENTICATE with AUT subkey) and wp11_openpgp_get_ard() (GET DATA 006E retrieval). Both functions use the mock CCID transport so no hardware is required. Need to add APDU-vector tests for each, verifying the command bytes sent and response handling.
